notes.title: 24.12.23 Ver 1.2 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Synergy[/h2]
[h3]New Synergy[/h3]

A new synergy <[b]Teenager>[/b] has been added.

[b]<Teenager>[/b] provides additional ‘Efficiency’ in generating memory points, based on the number of gears that exceed the power limit.

(2) 10% for every over gear count
(3) 20% for every over gear count
(4) 40% for every over gear count

[h3]Effect Adjustments[/h3]

The number of gears required for the <[b]Curiosity>[/b] has increased.

Level 1: 2 gears (unchanged)
Level 2: Increased from 3 to 4 gears

The effects of [b]<Curiosity>[/b] have also been changed.

Previously, the core gear’s power increased after completing a set number of rotations, and the rotation counts reset when the synergy was canceled by pulling out the gear.
But now, the rotation count will no longer reset, even if the synergy is canceled.
The maximum level of <[b]Confidence>[/b] has increased from 2 to 3.

(2) 5% per stack
(3) 10% per stack
[u](4) 15% per stack [b](new!)[/b][/u]

The maximum level and effects of <[b]Patience>[/b] have been adjusted.
(2) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 10%
(3) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 5%
[u](4) Reduce speed reduction due to lack of power: 20% -> 2% [b](new!)[/b][/u]

The maximum level of <[b]Greed>[/b] has increased from 2 to 3.

(2) Add + 0.5 production to each of <Greed> gears.
(3) In addition, add +0.5 production.
[u](4) In addition, add +1 production. [b](new!)[/b][/u]

[h2]Augment[/h2]
[h3]New Augments[/h3]

A new Augment <[b]Teenager Buff>[/b] has been added.
Effect: Increases memory generation of [b]<Teenager>[/b] gears by 1.

A new Augment <[b]Fruit of Sacrifice>[/b] has been added.
Effect: The supply cycle becomes shorter, but Power decreases by 1.

[h2]Supply[/h2]

The increment of supply gauge by recycling gears has been reduced.

[b]Gear Level 1[/b]: 10 → 4
[b]Gear Level 2[/b]: 20 → 6
[b]Gear Level 3[/b]: 30 → 8
[b]Gear Level 4[/b]: 40 → 10

[h2]Deck Button[/h2]

The deck button becomes more visible during the <Add Gear> and <Upgrade Gear> phases.

[h2]Text Events[/h2]

Based on user feedback, all text events can now be skipped.
Text events will now be displayed in smaller pop-up windows.
Some of the wrong sentences have been corrected.

[h2]Tutorial Description Changes[/h2]

Tutorial descriptions have been improved.

Updated the tutorial explanation videos.

[h2]Misc.[/h2]

The descriptions of <Love>, <Middle Age>, <Confidence>, and <Anxiety> have been clearer.
